title: Build a Presentation Outline with AI
description: Use AI to rapidly scaffold a compelling presentation structure — then refine it into something genuinely compelling.
steps: Define: topic, audience, goal, and time limit for your presentation

Prompt: "Create a presentation outline for [topic] aimed at [audience]. Goal: [what you want them to do or believe after]. Time: [X] minutes. Include: hook, 3 key sections, supporting points per section, and a clear call to action."
Ask: "What objections might this audience have? How should I address them?"
Build out one section in full with slide-level notes
expectedOutput: A complete presentation outline with alternative hooks, objection handling, and one fully developed section.
bonusChallenges: Ask AI to roleplay as a skeptical audience member and challenge the argument
Have AI suggest the 3 most impactful visuals for the presentation
